speaker: violeta
line: …someone was humming by the big frames. La Golondrina's tune — I know that tune.

speaker: ramon
line: …the crack ran down the left side. Nobody saw it but me.

speaker: luz
line: Ramón pocketed something silver by the cantina — I saw the flash, I swear it.

speaker: solorio
line: …I saw someone at the frames at dusk, humming — or did I dream it?
